sentences.text:
Awadesh Sharma S vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 28
February, 2022
Author: Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava

Bench: Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava
 1
 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 Mcrc No. 35005 of 2021
 (Awadesh Sharma S Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh)
Gwalior, Dated : 28-02-2022
 Shri Sanjay Bahirani, counsel for the petitioner.
 Shri Ravindra Singh, counsel for the respondent/State.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that despite various efforts he was unable to comply with the order dated 11.08.2021 passed by the coordinate Bench of this Court, whereby it was directed to file copy of notification issued by the State Government appointing an Additional District Magistrate to act as an Adjudicating Officer as provided under Section 68 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
It is further submitted that now under Section 68 of the aforesaid Act the Additional District Magistrate has issued notice against the petitioner.
Copy of aforesaid notice is available with the petitioner and is seeking time for filing of copy of aforesaid notice.

In the interest of justice, time is granted List the case in the week commencing 07.03.2022.
(RAJEEV KUMAR SHRIVASTAVA) JUDGE Van VANDANA VERMA 2022.03.02 11:04:49 -08'00'
